Elena — thanks for the W-9 and the bank summary. Ill start the vendor intake and loop procurement.

Quick answers: we prefer an XLSX intake (attached template) for bulk fields but can also accept the web form. Required fields we need up front: legal_entity_name, tax_id (TIN/EIN), remit_address, remit_email, invoice_format (PDF/EDI), primary_PO_contact (name/email/phone), and whether ACH or wire. Well also ask for a certificate of insurance for >$50k engagements.

Next steps Ill take:
- Attach the vendor_intake_form_redwood.xlsx for you to complete.
- Ill route to Procurement (Marissa) to validate tax & bank fields.
- Upon procurement OK, we create a vendor code and confirm PO routing.

ETA: typically 3-5 business days after we receive the completed intake + W-9 + remittance email. If you need faster, note in the intake and we can prioritize.

Attaching: vendor_intake_form_redwood.xlsx; po_routing_template.xlsx

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
